arxiv-2105-00148.title: Induced Quantized Spin Current in Vacuum
arxiv-2105-00148.creator: Chong-Sun Chu, Chun-Hei Leung
arxiv-2105-00148.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Chong-Sun Chu, Chun-Hei Leung. We uncover a fundamental effect of the QED vacuum in an external electromagnetic (EM) field. We show that the quantized vacuum of electrons is spin polarized by the EM field and manifests as a vacuum spin current. An experiment is proposed to measure the spin torque exerted by the spin current by measuring the twisted angle of the director axis of a nematic liquid crystal.

arxiv-2109-09662.title: Lagrangian Fillings in A-type and Their Kálmán Loop Orbits
arxiv-2109-09662.creator: James Hughes
arxiv-2109-09662.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by James Hughes. We compare two constructions of exact Lagrangian fillings of Legendrian positive braid closures, the Legendrian weaves of Casals-Zaslow, and the decomposable Lagrangian fillings, of Ekholm-Honda-Kálmán and show that they coincide for large families of Lagrangian fillings. As a corollary, we obtain an explicit correspondence between Hamiltonian isotopy classes of decomposable Lagrangian fillings of Legendrian ( 2 , n ) (2,n) torus links described by Ekholm-Honda-Kálmán and the weave fillings constructed by Treumann and Zaslow.

arxiv-2209-07195.creator: Ameneh Babaee, Behrooz Mashayekhy, Hanieh Mirebrahimi \coraut , Hamid Torabi, Mahdi Abdullahi Rashid, Seyyed Zeynal Pashaei
arxiv-2209-07195.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ameneh Babaee, Behrooz Mashayekhy, Hanieh Mirebrahimi \coraut , Hamid Torabi, Mahdi Abdullahi Rashid, Seyyed Zeynal Pashaei. By generalizing the whisker topology on the n n th homotopy group of pointed space ( X , x 0 ) (X,x_{0}) , denoted by π n w ​ h ​ ( X , x 0 ) \pi_{n}^{wh}(X,x_{0}) , we show that π n w ​ h ​ ( X , x 0 ) \pi_{n}^{wh}(X,x_{0}) is a topological group if n ≥ 2 n\geq 2 .

arxiv-2302-09681.title: Uniqueness of normalized ground states for NLS models
arxiv-2302-09681.creator: Hichem Hajaiej, Linjie Song
arxiv-2302-09681.description: Abstract We present two methods to prove the uniqueness of normalized ground states. We will first discuss the key ideas and ingredients of each method. Then, we will apply them to various classes of PDEs. Our approach is applicable to other operators, domains and nonlinearities provided that some hypotheses are satisfied.

arxiv-2508-13123.title: A time-adaptive optimization approach for reconstructing immune response in a mathematical model of acute HIV infection using clinical data
arxiv-2508-13123.creator: L. Beilina, I. Gainova, G. Bocharov
arxiv-2508-13123.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by L. Beilina, I. Gainova, G. Bocharov. The paper proposes a time-adaptive optimization approach for determining the time-dependent immune response function in a mathematical model of acute HIV infection, using clinical data from four untreated patients. We formulate the problem as a parameter identification problem for an immune response system of ODE which includes novel component integrated into the third equation of the classical three-equation HIV model.

arxiv-2512-02366.title: Universal Sensitivity Bound for Thermal Quantum Dynamic Sensing
arxiv-2512-02366.creator: Rui Zhang, Yang Yang, Wenkui Ding, Xiaoguang Wang
arxiv-2512-02366.description: Abstract This work unifies the equilibrium and non-equilibrium frameworks of quantum metrology within the context of many-body systems. We investigate dynamic sensing schemes to derive an upper bound on the quantum Fisher information for probe states in thermal equilibrium with their environment.

grick-clypeum-veritatis-1618.title: Clypeum veritatis: kurtze jedoch gründliche Antwort (1618)
grick-clypeum-veritatis-1618.creator: Friedrich Grick
grick-clypeum-veritatis-1618.description: Friedrich Grick’s 1618 Clypeum veritatis (Shield of Truth): a thorough answer in the Rosicrucian pamphlet war, engaging Menapius’s charges — one of the fullest contemporary defenses of the manifestos’ claims.

pmc-10545830.title: Nonnegative/Binary matrix factorization for image classification using quantum annealing
pmc-10545830.creator: Hinako Asaoka, Kazue Kudo
pmc-10545830.description: Classical computing has borne witness to the development of machine learning. The integration of quantum technology into this mix will lead to unimaginable benefits and be regarded as a giant leap forward in mankind’s ability to compute. Demonstrating the benefits of this integration now becomes essential.

pmc-10595466.title: Building Community Health Literacy with a Social Network Perspective
pmc-10595466.creator: T Sentell, K Saiki, M A Abrams, A Jones, K Melendez, J Chevrolet, M Roman, J Barnes, E Patterson
pmc-10595466.description: BackgroundThe COVID-19 pandemic underscored the vital importance of health literacy to combat misinformation, increase trust, and ensure health equity. Health literacy is a collective responsibility, including for organizations to “equitably enable individuals to find, understand, and use information and services.” This presentation will share key insights concerning health literacy in a social context.

pmc-11303866.title: A mixture of grass–legume cover crop species may ameliorate water stress in a changing climate
pmc-11303866.creator: Nhu Q Truong, Larry M York, Allyssa Decker, and Margaret R Douglas
pmc-11303866.description: Climate change models predict increasing precipitation variability in the mid-latitude regions of Earth, generating a need to reduce the negative impacts of these changes on crop production. Despite considerable research on how cover crops support agriculture in a changing climate, understanding is limited of how climate change influences the growth of cover crops.

pmc-11396334.title: Ionic Liquid-Based Extraction Strategy for the Efficient and Selective Recovery of Scandium
pmc-11396334.creator: Sheli Zhang, Yuerong Yan, Qiang Zhou, Yunchang Fan, Hector Rodriquez
pmc-11396334.description: The recovery of scandium (Sc) from highly acidic industrial effluents is currently hindered by the use of large quantities of flammable and toxic organic solvents. This study developed an extraction system using ionic liquids (ILs) and phenylphosphinic acid (PPAH) as diluents and an extractant, respectively, to selectively recover Sc from the aqueous phase.

pmc-11407423.title: Predictive value of TP53 RNAscope®in situ hybridization and p53 immunohistochemistry for TP53 mutational status in canine diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
pmc-11407423.creator: Greta Foiani, Luca Licenziato, Laura Marconato, Antonella Fanelli, Erica Melchiotti, Claudia Zanardello, Luca Aresu, Marta Vascellari
pmc-11407423.description: TP53 mutations are associated with short survival and poor treatment response in canine diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (cDLBCL). The expression of TP53 by RNAscope® in situ hybridization and p53 by immunohistochemistry (IHC) was investigated in 37 formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded cDLBCL, to assess their correlation with TP53 mutational status and to evaluate their prognostic value.

pmc-11426989.title: Screening for chronic kidney disease: change of perspective and novel developments
pmc-11426989.creator: Dominique van Mil, Lyanne M. Kieneker, Hiddo J.L. Heerspink, Ron T. Gansevoort
pmc-11426989.description: Purpose of reviewChronic kidney disease (CKD) is a serious health issue because of its rising global prevalence and its complications, such as kidney failure and cardiovascular disease (CVD). CKD is mainly diagnosed late or undiagnosed, delaying or missing the initiation of preventive interventions. Screening can prevent or delay progressive kidney function decline and CVD.

pmc-11660750.title: Unlocking the Potential of Deep Eutectic Solvents and Ligand‐to‐Metal Charge Transfer Processes: A Reusable Iron‐and‐UV‐Based System for Sustainable C−C Bond Formation
pmc-11660750.creator: Nerea González‐Gallardo, Alejandro Cores, Xavier Marset, Néstor Guijarro, Gabriela Guillena, Diego J. Ramón
pmc-11660750.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Catalytic C−H functionalization has provided new opportunities to access novel organic molecules more sustainably and efficiently. However, these procedures typically rely on precious metals or complex organic catalysts as well as on hazardous solvents or reaction conditions. Herein, a pioneering methodology for direct C−C bond formation enabled by Ligand‐to‐Metal Charge Transfer (LMCT) and mediated by UV irradiation has been developed using Deep Eutectic Solvents (DESs) as sustainable reaction media.

pmc-12554881.title: Improved classification of oral cancer through a personalized transfer learning CNN architecture
pmc-12554881.creator: Udita J Monani, Tae Soo Yun, Mangal Sain, Prasant Kumar Pattnaik
pmc-12554881.description: IntroductionOral cancer presents a significant danger to worldwide health, resulting in high death rates and substantial suffering. Early detection is crucial to improving treatment outcomes. This study uses deep learning techniques, particularly Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and transfer learning methodologies, to propose a dependable machine learning system for oral cancer detection.
